items.headline: Tech Rebound Attempts to Offset Broader Market Concerns on Monday
items.summary: U.S. equity futures showed a mixed picture on Monday, October 19, as technology stocks attempted a rebound after a significant sell-off last week. However, broader market sentiment remains cautious due to ongoing concerns about artificial intelligence investment sustainability, inflationary pressures, and geopolitical tensions. The CBOE Volatility Index (VIX) increased by 21.45% to 19.99 today, reflecting heightened investor anxiety.

items.headline: Disc Medicine Soars on Positive Drug Trial Results
items.summary: Disc Medicine shares surged after its investigational drug bitopertin met all primary and secondary endpoints in a Phase 3 trial for erythropoietic protoporphyria (EPP), a rare blood disorder.

items.headline: Cleveland-Cliffs Jumps on Strong Q3 Earnings
items.summary: The steelmaker's shares soared following a strong Q3 earnings report, with adjusted EPS beating estimates and improved guidance on adjusted EBITDA.

items.headline: Intel Climbs Following JPMorgan Upgrade
items.summary: Intel shares were climbing in premarket trading after JPMorgan upgraded the computer maker from Underweight to Neutral.

items.headline: Axis Bank Tumbles on Mixed Earnings Signals
items.summary: Axis Bank Ltd recorded the steepest decline among major Indian stocks, falling 4.19% as private lenders faced pressure after mixed earnings signals in the banking space.

items.headline: Infosys Drops Amid IT Sector Pressure
items.summary: Infosys Ltd fell as IT counters came under pressure in a session marked by broader market selling and caution on global demand.

items.headline: Energy and Consumer Staples Lead as Market Rotates from Growth
items.summary: A significant sector rotation is underway, with Energy Select Sector SPDR ($XLE) rising 2.5% today. Consumer Staples and Utilities have also moved into a 'confirmed Leading' position for the week, indicating a defensive and commodity-tilted macro theme. Conversely, Information Technology has confirmed an exit from its leading position after two weeks of weakening.

items.headline: Fed Officials Eye AI Boom as Persistent Inflation Driver
items.summary: Federal Reserve officials are increasingly acknowledging the artificial intelligence investment boom as a lasting source of inflation. While the Fed is in its quiet period from October 17-29, the central bank's benchmark rate was raised to 3.75%-4.00% in September, with expectations of holding steady at the upcoming October 27-28 meeting.

items.headline: China's Economy Outperforms Expectations in Q3
items.summary: China's gross domestic product (GDP) expanded by 4.5% year-on-year in the third quarter of 2026, accelerating from 4.3% in the previous quarter and surpassing economists' forecasts of 4.4%. This stronger growth provided some reassurance about China's economic performance.

items.headline: Major Earnings Reports on Deck This Week
items.summary: A busy week for corporate earnings is ahead, with key reports expected from tech giants Meta Platforms ($META), Tesla ($TSLA), IBM ($IBM), and Netflix ($NFLX), among others. These results will be crucial in testing investor confidence in the tech sector following recent volatility.
